name: Evidence Action's Syphilis Free Start, Liberia (The Life You Can Save, 2025)
beneficiaries_note: The model's name: Evidence Action's Syphilis Free Start, Liberia (The Life You Can Save, 2025).

missing_data.note: Measured: Evidence Action counts the pregnant women tested and treated against the rates before the programme, and the birth outcomes averted rest on the effect of penicillin treatment of maternal syphilis from trials and cohort studies.

summary: Evidence Action helps Liberia's health system test pregnant women for syphilis at antenatal visits and treat those infected with penicillin, to prevent stillbirths, newborn deaths and congenital syphilis. The Life You Can Save counts Evidence Action's estimate of the adverse birth outcomes averted from 2020 to 2024 and divides by the programme's cost to date, the Global Fund's tests and drugs included. Our view values the stillbirths and newborn deaths the site's way; the biggest uncertainties are Evidence Action's own estimate of outcomes averted and the split between stillbirths and newborn deaths.

rows.explainer: Evidence Action's deaths combine stillbirths and newborns' deaths without a split. WHO's estimates for 2016 put the deaths from maternal syphilis at 143,000 early fetal deaths and stillbirths and 61,000 newborn deaths: 70% stillbirths. The range is ours.

rows.label: Value of averting one of these deaths, in healthy years
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** The sheet counts every stillbirth and newborn death at the remaining life expectancy at age 2.5, discounted (28.8 years). The site values a stillbirth and a newborn's death by GiveWell's weights for each, times the value-of-a-life slider, in healthy years at Your values' exchange rate.
